AVT.what: Global distributor of electronic components and embedded solutions, supplying engineers and manufacturers with semiconductors, passive parts, boards and supply-chain services.

ZS.what: Cloud security platform (Zero Trust Exchange) that secures users, devices and workloads by connecting them to apps through its own cloud, replacing network firewalls and VPNs.

ETN.what: Power-management company making electrical distribution, data-centre power, aerospace and vehicle components, serving utilities, data centres and industrial customers.

META.what: Operator of Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger; earns mostly from advertising and is investing heavily in AI and Reality Labs.

GDDY.what: Domain-name, web-hosting and website-builder provider that sells domains, hosting, security and commerce tools to small businesses and individuals.

ITT.what: Maker of engineered flow-control, motion-control and connector components for industrial, transportation and energy markets.

VRSN.what: Operator of the authoritative registry for the .com and .net domains and provider of internet infrastructure and security services.

PLTR.what: Data-analytics and AI software company whose Gotham, Foundry and AIP platforms serve government, defense and commercial customers.

GOOGL.what: Parent of Google: search and YouTube advertising, Google Cloud, Android and Waymo, with large AI investments across the stack.

SNAP.what: Camera and messaging company behind Snapchat, earning mainly from advertising and a growing subscription (Snapchat+) business.
